profile_text.body:
Autodesk's Tinkercad is described on its site as a free, easy-to-use app for 3D design, electronics, and coding. The site presents it as a tool for those areas of design and making.

The product is tracked in the Education and Research AI category. No AI features are recorded for it. Its uses are 3D design, circuits, and code blocks, and its audience is students and teachers of all ages. For users under 13, parent or teacher consent is required, and teacher-linked class accounts are available. It is free, and it holds kidSAFE COPPA Safe Harbor certification alongside the Autodesk Children's Privacy Statement dated April 2026.
